channel.title: The Radar: what is shooting in Australia, New Zealand and Southeast Asia
channel.description: Changes to the production map, checked every week. Every pin links to its public sources.

item.title: The Radar, 25 November 2026
item.description: Added Lenni (Apple TV, Sydney), The Artful Dodger season 3 (Disney+, Sydney), Bluefly (Gold Coast), Slander (Stan, Melbourne), 2 Moons (Parramatta), Plague (Dandenong Ranges), Pilli Sisters PI (ABC, Perth), Don't Look (NSW Outback), The Day We Start Again and Goreng! (Kuala Lumpur) and We Could Be in Love (Manila). Off the map: The Girl Who Was Plugged In and the Crazy Rich Asians series, which have no current public source for where or when they shoot. On the map now: 21 productions, 16 shooting and 5 in pre-production.

item.title: The Radar, 20 November 2026
item.description: Added Queenstown (Netflix, New Zealand). Also on now: McLeod's Daughters (regional Victoria), Chan and You've Changed (Auckland), and an untitled FX pilot (Bangkok). On the map now: 12 productions, 8 shooting and 4 in pre-production.

item.title: The Radar, 19 November 2026
item.description: Map rebuilt: seven productions, each with two or three public sources. On the map now: 7 productions, 5 shooting and 2 in pre-production.
